qualification_harness.cmake_source:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(FilesPaneSanitizers LANGUAGES CXX)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${SOURCE}" SOURCE)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${FIXTURES}" FIXTURES)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
find_package(ckvision 1.4.0 CONFIG REQUIRED)
include("${SOURCE}/cmake/CkToolsStrict.cmake")
if(MSVC)
 add_compile_options(/fsanitize=address)
 add_link_options(/DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO)
else()
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
set(BUILD_TESTING ON)
enable_testing()
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files" core)
add_library(ck_vision_shell STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/suite_shell.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_shell PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include")
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_shell PUBLIC ckvision::cvision)
cktools_strict(ck_vision_shell)
add_library(ck_vision_cktest_main STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/host/cktest_main.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/tests/support")
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC ckvision::cvision)
target_compile_definitions(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC CKTOOLS_TEST_TEMP_ROOT="${FIXTURES}")
cktools_strict(ck_vision_cktest_main)
add_library(ck_options STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/common/options/options.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_options PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include" PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/tools/json-view/include")
target_compile_features(ck_options PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
add_library(ck_vision_keymap STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/keymap/keymap.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/keymap/suite_keymap_catalog.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include" PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/tools/json-view/include")
target_compile_features(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC ckvision::cvision ck_options)
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/vision/files" ui)

add_executable(ck_files_directory_row_tests "${SOURCE}/tests/unit/ck_files/test_files_path_native.cpp" "${SOURCE}/tests/unit/ck_files/test_files_path.cpp" "${SOURCE}/tests/unit/ck_files/test_files_indexed_pane.cpp" "${SOURCE}/tests/unit/ck_files/test_files_index_file_native.cpp")
target_link_libraries(ck_files_directory_row_tests PRIVATE ck_files_platform ck_vision_cktest_main)
target_compile_definitions(ck_files_directory_row_tests PRIVATE CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT="${CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT}")
cktools_strict(ck_files_directory_row_tests)
add_test(NAME directory_row_core COMMAND ck_files_directory_row_tests --suite test_files_indexed_pane.cpp)
add_test(NAME directory_row_native COMMAND ck_files_directory_row_tests --suite test_files_index_file_native.cpp)
set_tests_properties(directory_row_core directory_row_native PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 180)

add_test(NAME requested_paths COMMAND ck_files_directory_row_tests --suite test_files_path.cpp)
set_tests_properties(requested_paths PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)

add_test(NAME native_home_paths COMMAND ck_files_directory_row_tests --suite test_files_path_native.cpp)
set_tests_properties(native_home_paths PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)

service_race_harness.cmake_source:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(FilesPaneThreadSanitizer LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
include("${SOURCE}/cmake/CkToolsStrict.cmake")
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_compile_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
add_link_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-sanitize-recover=all)
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files" core)
add_executable(pane_service_tsan "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_location.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_location_text.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_pane_service.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/tests/files_pane_service_tests.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/host/cktest_main.cpp")
target_include_directories(pane_service_tsan PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files" "${SOURCE}/tests/support" "${SDK}/include")
target_compile_definitions(pane_service_tsan PRIVATE CKTOOLS_TEST_TEMP_ROOT="${FIXTURES}" CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT="${PRIVATE_FIXTURES}")
target_link_libraries(pane_service_tsan PRIVATE ck_files_platform Threads::Threads)
cktools_strict(pane_service_tsan)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME pane_service_tsan COMMAND pane_service_tsan)
set_tests_properties(pane_service_tsan PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
service_race_harness.scope: UI-free worker/native protocol; no ckVision binary or UI controller/grid race qualification claimed.

windows_stress_harness.scope: Existing instrumented 100000-row native stress wall-clock guard; all data, storage/wire/advance bounds and assertions remain unchanged.

review.semantics: Ctrl+L and the Location menu open the public ckVision modal form. The draft retains an exact native route independently of its editable text. Unchanged acceptance preserves route components and current pane state. Explicit edits submit through the existing latest-navigation worker protocol; no native I/O occurs in UI dispatch.
review.limits: Service path/depth configuration governs editor validation. Text has an explicit codec budget; the public InputLine buffer is not claimed to have a hard allocation cap. Invalid input and lossy format switches retain text/mode and veto navigation. Missing or rejected startup addresses recover from an empty draft without guessing cwd/root/home.
review.cases: Six new draft cases and ten new application cases cover exact/native formats and quotas, all five themes, real command/keymap dispatch, tiny resizing and Go button, startup recovery, stale navigation, quit/cancel, external detach, queued-result withdrawal and superseding blocked discovery. Existing literal-native-name UI coverage now exercises the editor too.
review.excluded: An initial Mac compile failed on a strict shadow warning in a lambda capture. The capture was renamed; that failed build is not qualification of final source.
review.scope: WP-02 remains open for bounded asynchronous completion, history/bookmarks, qualified refresh, properties/preview, production executable and actual terminal acceptance. No source mutation command or production GUI launch introduced.

timing_investigation.interpretation: Actual compile actions, sanitizer flags, input/object/output hashes, case sets and cleanup are checked. Mac full SDK/product and service builds completed faster than the preceding milestone. All 124 SDK, 82 product and 65 worker units were freshly compiled with the expected instrumentation and source hashes, with no cache wrapper or skipped build. Observed load/swap was lower than the prior resource observation; this is context rather than an asserted sole cause. Windows native-index stress took 275.22 seconds and the UI suite 47.12 seconds (333.55 seconds total). The observed native-test PID used the expected V drive executable and had accumulated 188.125 CPU seconds while running. Exact final case sets and unchanged native-fixture hashes were verified; no native assertions, stress size or timeout were changed. The existing 600-second native stress guard remains. No compiler-cache wrapper is configured; elapsed time alone is not freshness proof.
